title: Coordinate-Governed Mapping of Source-Local Scientific Projections: A Fixed-Panel Study
description:
Brief Report manuscript (PDF, editable DOCX and LaTeX source) prepared for submission to F1000Research. The article reports a bounded fixed-panel methods observation: on a prospectively frozen, case-identifier-disjoint 32-case holdout of already-structured scientific projections, a complete polarity-sensitive non-merge condition avoided the six false agreements created by a registered flat predicate-canonicalization rule, with the predeclared false-split guard satisfied; a separate deterministic eight-state conformance battery and an information-equivalent typed implementation reproduce the registered interfaces.

The work does not claim population error rates, superiority over deployed integration systems, raw-text extraction performance or downstream scientific utility. The frozen case records, protocols, deterministic analyses and independent implementation checks are available in the related ORION repository snapshot.
